question: What is the percentage change in the non-controlling interest share of loss from 2018 to 2019 for Intu-Properties?
retrieval_query: percentage change in non-controlling interest share of loss from 2018 to 2019 for Intu-Properties
answer:
Percentage change in non-controlling interest share of loss from 2018 to 2019:

2018: £12.7 million  
2019: £70.9 million  

Change = 70.9 - 12.7 = £58.2 million  
Percentage change = (58.2 / 12.7) × 100 ≈ 458.3%

Source: 1614d46700363e699110c89aaf7e5ba5.pdf p.1
